statements: Reports can be downloaded now, but the browser saves them under a meaningless name. Add downloadHeaders(report) to src/download.mjs, returning the response headers for a report, so the browser saves it under the title the customer gave it, followed by .pdf.
Customers write titles in any language and with any characters they like.
The headers include content-type application/pdf and the file's byte length as content-length. Everything else stays as it is. The new behaviour has tests in test/.
brief: Add download headers for reports, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
